description: Find every place a name is used in the project, offline: a function, signal, variable, constant, class_name, autoload, input action, group or node name, or a res:// path / uid:// (which files refer to it, and whether it exists). Looks in GDScript (not comments), in strings where Godot looks names up (connect, emit_signal, is_action_pressed, add_to_group, get_node, load), in scene connections, node names and groups, and in project settings. Returns the definition, then each use with file, line, kind and the line itself (very common names are capped). Call it before you rename, move or delete anything; godot_rename makes the change everywhere. Read-only.

name.description: what to look for, e.g. take_damage, health_changed, Player, jump, res://scenes/enemy.tscn

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

name: godot_usages
title: Find usages
